title: Project AQUILINE drone in flight (CIA reconnaissance history, Appendix E, p. 340)
description: Large black-and-white photograph of the AQUILINE small unmanned aircraft, a long-winged, bird-like drone, flying low over dark terrain. The caption reads "Project AQUILINE." Text below describes its 60-knot design speed, 1968 tests at the Naval Ordnance Test Station at China Lake, and its bright orange paint for chase-aircraft visibility.
